name: War-Torn City
trigger: When you spend a day in the war-torn city,

roll.label: the tier of the city's {war-torn} status

outcomes.text: the day passes and the MC chooses one from the list below.
options: A checkpoint turns you back and you lose the rest of the day.
Someone you were counting on has fled the district.
A shell falls close enough to leave you {rattled-2}.
The rubble gives up something useful, but it belongs to someone still alive.

outcomes.text: the day passes and the MC chooses two from the list above.
options: A checkpoint turns you back and you lose the rest of the day.
Someone you were counting on has fled the district.
A shell falls close enough to leave you {rattled-2}.
The rubble gives up something useful, but it belongs to someone still alive.

outcomes.text: the MC chooses three from the list above, and the city takes an interest in you.

frequency: Once per day spent in the city.
mc_note: The list is the city, not a punishment table. Pick what the fiction has already been pointing at.
